app: Flow test app (created 2026-09-11, PKCE + token rotation, not distributed through the Marketplace)
grant: user token (xoxp, rotating) for the designated test workspace, scopes: chat:write + channels/groups/im/mpim :read + :history + users:read
method: Direct calls to slack.com/api with the grant's user token from a local script; one call every 1 s or 5 s as stated; no retries. Status, Retry-After, and object counts recorded; no message content stored.

runs.result: 60/60 HTTP 200, n=5 each, has_more=false, no 429, no warning field
runs.note: Explained by the idle run below: a fresh grant starts with a full burst bucket (~60), which this run drained.

runs.result: limit=200 → 200 OK with n=15, has_more=true, next_cursor present; limit=15 → 429 ratelimited; limit=3 → 429 ratelimited
200 OK at t=1, 47, 104, 166 s (n=15 each); every other call 429 ratelimited with Retry-After: 60
runs.conclusion: one successful call per ~60 s sliding window; cap of 15 objects per response

runs.cadence: every 5 s for 60 s, started ~2 s after the previous run
runs.result: 429 at t=1, 6; 200 OK (n=0) at t=11; 429 for the rest
runs.conclusion: the budget is per app + team + method, shared across channels

runs.cadence: 5 min with no history calls, then every 5 s for 60 s on the DM, then every 5 s for 60 s on #testing
runs.result: DM: 8 × 200 OK (t = 1–37 s) then 429 with Retry-After 60 for the rest; #testing right after: 429 until t = 32 s, one 200 (n=15), then 429
runs.conclusion: burst allowance that refills while idle (~1 credit per minute, 8 available after 5 min), then a sustained rate of 1 per minute. This also explains the first run: a never-used grant started with a full bucket (60 calls) and drained it.
replies was NOT limited to 1/min in this run; unresolved whether it has a separate budget or a larger one

discoveryWithReadScopes.result: 200 OK, 16 conversations, keys channels/ok/response_metadata, no cursor

postMessageDuringFill: 12 × chat.postMessage through the connector at ~1.1 s spacing: 12/12 HTTP 200 (tier 'special' 1/s per channel not hit)
